reviews.text: Our Havanese (10 mo) absolutely loved her time at Z Dog!! They are fantastic and provide lots of personal care and attention for your pet. From the orientation and first visit, it is apparent what a truly positive, thoughtful and safe environment for your dog to be!! It was our dog’s first experience with day care and she has more than a little bit of separation anxiety and can be a quite demanding of attention!! But she bonded immediately to everyone there and absolutely loved running like crazy in the outdoor area they have. Thanks so much to the team at Z!!

I called this place to ask about daycare today and a lady answered. This lady speaks broken English and is VERY rude. She explained 1 sentence about daycare with impatient voice and suddenly decide to hang up. I called again, as soon as she heard my voice she hanged up. I don’t understand, I called to ask about your business so YOU CAN EARN MONEY FROM ME; then why being so rude?
I am a foreigner and English is not my first language. I completely understand the struggle and stress of answering phone call with a foreign language. I have all the patience to let you explain your business. But hanging up the phone won’t help with communication.
I don’t trust you watching my dog.

I feel so lucky to have found Z Dog for our dog Ruby! She was always excited to arrive at Z Dog and it was clear that she was well taken care of and loved by the staff. We are sad that we’ll have to find a new daycare since we’ve moved out of the area, and we would recommend Z Dog to anyone looking for care for their small dog!

Hello Chao,
Thank you for your excellent review - we appreciate the care that you entrust us with your dog.
Z Dog Daycare
Great place and great people. Our dog goes a few times per week and cannot wait to get there. Easy to book and lots of flexibility. Highly recommended!

Jose and team took great care of my two dogs for 2 years while I lived in Philadelphia.  My dogs were like a part of their family.  My older pup had a difficult transition when we first moved and Jose was very patient and worked with us to find a solution that would allow my dog to continue coming to daycare safely.  I feel that other places would not have given us the consideration or adjustment period my dog needed.  The pups eventually adjusted and had a great time at Z Dog.  They even provided pick-up and drop-off services.

Hi Ginny ! 
We appreciate supporting you with experienced, loving pet care for your sweet puppy . Thank you for the 5 star review! 

Natalie,  José,  & Kelev 
Z Dog Daycare

Our dog Lila has been cared for for the past 4 years by Z dog. They have been nothing short of life savers on many occasions when life was hectic, and always ensure Lila is well exercised and well taken care of! She enjoys walks, daycare and pet cations, and always comes home happy and excited!

I've been taking my dog to Z Dog since I adopted my dog Phoebe in October! Phoebe loves playing outside there and goes 3-4 times per week. I work long hours in healthcare so the pick up/drop off option is a life saver! Phoebe has done several overnight stays with the Z dog family while I've gone on vacation. No one I trust more with her!

My pup and I love Z Dog!
As soon as the door opens, Pancake runs right up the steps ready to play with his friends. I love that he has a nice, open outdoor area to run off leash in!
Nights after a day at Z Dog are relaxing and filled with naps. I was nervous about the thought of sending him to daycare but I know he is well taken care of by everybody here. Thanks for giving me peace of mind while I have to go to the office!

Our pup (1.5 year old golden doodle) has been going to Z dog for over a year now, and she LOVES it. Comes home tired after playing all day, and eagerly pulls towards the entrance in the morning. Whenever I pick her up, she is happy and all the providers are kind and professional. . We have also used them for a weekend away---also a great experience.
Natalie and Jose are wonderful to work with and easy to contact, the space is great, and the price is reasonable.
I would recommend to anyone looking for care for their dog!

Z Dog is a life saver. Since I started daycare for my high energy puppy, she’s been so tired at the end of the day that there’s less chance for mischief at home 😝. She’s happy to go socialize with her friends as well as Natalie, Jose and the rest of the caring staff when I drop her off in the morning. And I get a great, big hug from her when I pick her up in the evening. Highly recommended.
Our dog absolutely loves Z Dog! They have a great outdoor space (rare for Philly) and the owners take great care of our pup. Highly recommended!
